title: Chess and the Comet
description: Three women in Victorian black dresses sit around an ornate chessboard with glowing golden pieces. Behind them, a large circular vault door stands open, revealing a bright comet streaking across a starry night sky framed by vines and white roses.
prompt: Three women dressed in black Victorian clothing sit at an ornate table playing chess with large glowing golden pieces. One woman rests her chin on her hand while another writes in a book. Behind them a massive circular metallic vault door is open, revealing a dramatic comet with a long tail streaking across a deep blue starry sky. The scene is framed by thorny vines and white roses. Dark, symbolic, and surreal atmosphere with high contrast lighting.
